summary: CASH BUYERS ONLY! Situated east of Carlisle in a historic rural setting, yet conveniently close to Brampton and the A689, this well-proportioned detached dormer bungalow offers four double bedrooms and spacious, flexible accommodation, set within a generous garden plot with off-road parking and a garage.
description:
Offered to the market with no onward chain, Romanway is presented in well-maintained, neutral décor throughout and offers excellent scope for modernisation and personalisation. It represents a superb opportunity to acquire a highly desirable and versatile style of family home.

Conveniently positioned for easy access to Carlisle, Brampton and the M6 motorway, the property is set within the Hadrian's Wall World Heritage Site and occupies mature yet manageable gardens.

Constructed in the style of a dormer bungalow, the well-planned ground floor accommodation comprises a welcoming reception hallway with galleried landing above, a dual-aspect living room featuring a sandstone fireplace, a separate dining room, and a fitted kitchen. There are also two double bedrooms and a shower room on this level.

To the first floor are two further double bedrooms, an additional bathroom, and a useful walk-in linen cupboard/store.

Externally, a boiler room sits adjacent to the kitchen, together with a garage, while the surrounding gardens provide pleasant outdoor space.

Likely to generate strong interest, early viewing is highly recommended to fully appreciate the space, setting, and potential on offer.

Directions From Carlisle, head north east onto the A689 towards Brampton. Take a left turn just before Carlisle airport and keep following this road. At the junction turn left and the house is on the right hand side after 350 metres.

Services Oil powered central heating with mains electric and water being connected. Neither these services nor any boilers or radiators have been tested.

Drainage is to a septic tank. Any alterations required to meet current regulations are to be the responsibility of the purchaser. The septic tank is non-compliant. The price has been reduced to reflect the need to upgrade the septic tank.

Key Information: • Standard construction. • We understand that broadband and mobile telephone reception are available. For an indication of speeds and supply please see the OFCOM website: • There is private off road vehicle parking. • The property lies within the Hadrian’s Wall World Heritage Site.
